note: Both sets accurately extract the elevation data (Grade Level 0'-0" and Finished Floor 2'-9 1/2") for both the East and West modules, though both suffer from significant redundancy by stating the same facts multiple times with slight variations. Set B is superior because it also correctly extracts the drawing scales (3/8" = 1'-0") for both sections, which are present in the text layer and image but missing from Set A. Neither set contains factually incorrect values, but Set B is more comprehensive.
